points.description: Names both phases (slow start and congestion avoidance) and correctly describes how cwnd changes in each: slow start = cwnd increases by 1 per ACK (exponential growth, doubling per RTT) while cwnd < ss_thresh; congestion avoidance (cwnd >= ss_thresh) = cwnd grows more slowly (linearly). Also states that on loss/congestion ss_thresh is set to cwnd/2 and cwnd is reset to 1. Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Award no partial marks unless the marking teacher decides otherwise; all parts (both phases, cwnd behaviour, ss_thresh = cwnd/2 and cwnd reset to 1 on loss) are expected for the single mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark: both phases named, cwnd growth in each described (fast/exponential vs slower/linear), and the loss reaction (ss_thresh = cwnd/2, cwnd = 1). Missing the phase names, growth behaviour or the loss adaptation earns no mark. Equivalent wording is accepted.
